ce_ability: CHA or INT (player's choice, locked at creation)
concept: She commanded eighty thousand pirates and retired with a pardon — and nobody retires from this.

features.name: Sign the Articles
features.text: Up to **PB willing creatures** become Crew during a rest. They can always leave at the next rest; there is no punishment for refusing renewal. Consent is the hull — a Crew member who turns hostile or acts under compulsion loses Crew status immediately, and while fewer than two willing Crew remain, the Fund locks.

features.name: General Fund
features.text: Each Crew member may deposit up to **PB CE** (Fund cap 2 × your level + PB); deposited CE leaves the personal pool. Once per turn, a Crew member within 60 ft may draw 1 CE to pay part of one legal CE cost. **No CE is created** — the Articles gather, they do not conjure.

features.cost_line: Reaction · 2 Fund CE · once per round.
features.name: Article of Mutual Defense
features.text: When a Crew member within 60 ft fails a save or takes damage, another Crew member may spend **2 Fund CE** to add PB to the save or reduce the damage by 2 × PB. The assister decides.

features.name: Articles May Be Amended
features.text: After a short rest, the Crew may unanimously add one table-written Article (GM-approved). Any signer rejecting means no amendment.

features.name: Amnesty
features.text: Offer explicit surrender terms to one hostile that understands them. If accepted and witnessed, both sides are bound for 24 hours; a knowing violator takes **5 × PB psychic damage** and loses PB CE. Terms cannot require suicide, slavery, soul-surrender, or unrelated future obedience.

features.name: Pension & Exit
features.text: At the end of an objective, any Crew member may leave permanently and withdraw up to their contribution. Amnesty-honorers cannot be hunted by the Crew for the term.

l20.name: The Fleet Stands Down
l20.text: Your Amnesty is no longer offered to one hostile — it may be offered to **every hostile that can hear and understand the terms** within 120 ft, all bound by the same witnessed 24-hour terms if they accept. She priced surrender until surrender was the winning move; eighty thousand pirates stood down, and so can this field.

maximum.name: Red Flag Confederation
maximum.text: The Fund's range becomes 120 ft; a Crew member may draw **any amount** for one activation, and other willing Crew may use their Reaction to contribute personal CE (up to PB each) toward one activation. May pay Domain Expansion costs (per zack's ruling).

title: ZHENG YI SAO
